people.imagined: His tent at night after news that the road is quiet. He has gone very still, one hand on the jade cup that glows on his belt, thinking of the son who is far away.
people.subject: The moment: in a dark tent at night he has gone very still, one hand resting on a glowing jade cup, and looks at the viewer from under heavy brows. Face: huge and grey-bearded, about sixty-two, a broad weathered face with an old burn across the left cheek and temple, fierce dark eyes softened by thought, a thick grey beard. Hair: grey, under a dark night-blue silk headwrap fixed with a gold pin. Body: huge, broad-shouldered, a rider's bulk. Clothing: robes of deep night-blue and dune-gold silk under a flowing sand-coloured gauze over-robe, the collars embroidered with crescent moons and stars in pale gold, a broad sash. Hands and objects: one big scarred hand rests on a small jade cup on his sash that glows with a soft green-white night light; a curved sabre in a black-and-gold scabbard lies across his knees. Power: a faint heat-shimmer of red and silver qi rises from the sabre's guard. Background: the blurred inside of a desert tent, rugs and a lamp. Light: the cup's cool glow from below and warm lamplight from the upper left. Expression: wrathful by nature, quiet now, thinking of someone far away.
